units.title: Introduction to Basics of sketching with various tools and materials
topics: 1.1. Introduction to sketching tools and materials - Drawing and sketching tools and materials such as Pencil, Pen, Ink pen, Pencil colours, Sketch pen, Felt tip pen, Markers, Water colour, Pastel colour, Acrylic colour, Charcoal pencil/chalk, Brush, Crayon wax, Drawing sheets/paper, Drawing book, Drawing board, etc.
1.2. Sketching Techniques – Stippling, Scribbling, Circling, Smooth Shading & Blending, Creating Highlights and Rendering
uos: 1.a. Carryout free hand sketching using different tools and techniques.

units.title: Elements of Design
topics: 2.2. Linear elements- Line: Definition of line, Different types of line, Aspects of line, its physical and psychological effects on human figure. (Horizontal, Vertical, Diagonal, Curved, Zigzag)
2.3. Planar elements- Primary shapes, Regular and irregular
2.4. Volumetric elements - Properties of Form, Types of form: Centralized, Linear, Radial, clustered, gridform, Transformation of form
2.5. Colour and Texture - Colour wheel, colour schemes, Texture etc. (etc. should not be there)
uos: 2.a. Draw the given types of point elements and linear elements
2.b. Draw the given types of Planar and volumetric elements
2.c. Analyze architectural Form in given examples through sketch (pl check)
2.d. Prepare sketches using relevant types of form and transformation of the given form (pl check)
2.e. Prepare colour wheel, colour texture and colour schemes for a given situation.

units.title: Principles of Design and 2D Composition
topics: 3.1. Design Principles - Representation techniques focusing on Axis, Symmetry, Hierarchy, Harmony, Balance, Emphasis, Rhythm, Scale, Proportion, Repetition, etc.

3.2. 2D Geometrical Composition using elements and principles of Basic Design Course Code: 4315004 NITTTR Bhopal – GTU - COGC-2021 Curriculum Topics and Sub-topics design with tone & texture, figure & ground, colour and shading, etc.
uos: 3.b. Create 2D geometrical composition using elements and principle of design

units.title: Freehand sketching
topics: 4.1. Live Object Drawing- Furniture, Part of Building i.e Door, Windows, Gate, Arch, Dome etc.
4.2. Freehand sketches from memory – Memory Sketching

4.3. Indoor & Outdoor sketching - Basic free-hand Perspective drawing for interior of rooms- Foyer, Living Room, Kitchen, Bedroom, View from balcony, Garden, Campus, Worm’s Eye View, Bird’s Eye View, etc.
uos: 4.a. Draw freehand sketches of a given furniture and building elements
4.b. Draw the freehand sketches from memory

units.title: Model Making and 3D Composition
topics: 5.1. Models of geometrical objects using Clay, Thermocole sheet, Card board, Paper, Wire, Wood, etc.
5.2. Composition of Models - 3D Geometrical Composition using elements of design and sketch with light & shade, figure & ground, colour and shading, etc.
uos: 5.a. Prepare models of a given geometrical object using different types of materials such as clay, card board etc.
5.b. Prepare models of 3D geometrical compositions using elements of design
